source_reasoning: Only one-action parents can share their unique action child. Existing learning path reads child CFV into vc[0], computes regret before final CFV store; locked and opponent paths read the same hand before final store. No cross-hand reads in up_action, and cfv is a single non-restrict mutable pointer. Disjoint pairs require child arity>=2; actual lifetime and graph controls exclude all other same-stage row collisions and any chance-orbit reference to the shared child. No CUDA recompilation, resource/counter query, early store, dispatch, float, update or schedule change.
compiled_resource_scope: Exact accepted CUDA/PTX reused. Per-kernel registers/local/shared/ABI/launch unchanged by host allocator. Aggregate graph/device/host peak/capacity and CPU costs still require integrated measurement.
raw_control_scope: 819 disjoint/aliased cases. Full logical parent CFV, whole regret/strategy arrays, full expected physical output/guard images and all actual input bytes. Arity>1 remains disjoint, na1 in-place. No claim that distinct physical CFV layouts are byte-identical.
